study_note: One fresh seed-55 AMBI Dog Walk run with five critics and MRS.Q-style aggregation: min over all critics for inner/outer TD targets and terminal bootstrap, mean over all critics for both actors, without pair sampling. Preserve the Dog Stand Q5 learner, 1M decisions, sampled H3/J8/K1, N128/C16/A4/B256, fixed joint post-tanh entropy 0.0021, action-local adaptive scaling, all 25k checkpoints and critic geometry every 1k outer updates.
